Class-Theoretic Glossary & Disambiguation Matrix

Authoritative reference specifications for foundational concepts in Morse-Kelley class theory with tagged pairs (MKTD1 / MKTD2).

Concept Glossary Record (Internal Table)
01
TermDunaev Tagged Ordered Pair (⟨A, B⟩D)
Formal Definition(A, B)_D ≡ mark(A, 1) ∪ mark(B, 2) = ({1} × A) ∪ ({2} × B)
Source ReferenceGeorgy Dunaev, set_theory_prover/program/types/foundations.ML (entries 3.76 DefDunaevOrderedPair, 3.77 ThmDunaevFirstProjection, 3.78 ThmDunaevSecondProjection).
Soundness for ClassesIn Morse-Kelley class theory, proper classes cannot be elements of other classes. Kuratowski pairs {{a}, {a, b}} require a, b ∈ V and fail for proper classes. Dunaev tagged pairs are universally sound for all classes (including V and On), satisfying π1((A,B)_D) = A, π2((A,B)_D) = B, and injectivity.
02
TermDunaev Class-List ([X1, ..., Xn])
Formal DefinitionInductive finite sequence using Dunaev tagged pairs: [] ≡ ∅, [X] ≡ (X, [])_D, [X1, X2] ≡ (X_1, (X_2, [])_D)_D.
Source ReferenceGeorgy Dunaev, set_theory_prover/program/types/foundations.ML (entry 3.39: DefClassLists).
Syntactic RoleMulti-argument class tuples, sequent hypothesis contexts Γ, and explicit substitution environments without requiring higher-universe conglomerates.
03
TermKernel Context Environments (Δ vs Γ)
Variable Signature ΔDeclares object-language variables and their sorts: Δ = { z : Class, A : Class, F : Class }. Scoped by universal binders (ELam).
Hypothesis Context ΓStores local propositional assumptions: Γ = { hIn : (z ∈ {x | ⊥}) }. Scoped by implication binders (EFn).
Judgement FormIn Δ; Γ ⊢ e : T, Δ scopes free variables while Γ scopes active proof hypotheses.
